description: Admissible proposal evidence: reconciliation meta_reported is the existing Meta-reported conversions count compared with gateway_verified accepted conversions. The separate purchases block shows Meta-reported Purchase counts under the account attribution setting beside Plainrouter accepted server-side Purchase counts, with its completed account-local window start and end dates and no purchase gap or status. Includes stored daily Meta spend and delivery metrics. platform_claimed_clicks means Meta outbound clicks. Days before 2026-06-29, or not re-read by the daily sync since 2026-09-27, may still hold Meta link clicks or all clicks.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID. Signals reads use the workspace Meta destination when omitted; other tools may require an ID when multiple accounts are active.

days.description: Number of reporting days to compare, from 1 to 90.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.
